data.body: LOCAL OPUS REVIEW (pre-manual-merge of PR #689): cycle 1 found 1 important + 3 minor; ALL FIXED in 7326290bb5 (removed -X ours data-loss → abort-on-conflict; portable mkdir-lock + RETURN cleanup → no fd leak / macOS-portable; checkout -b → no clobber). Cycle 2 (confirming) = 0 critical/important/fragile, 3 MINOR (reviewer hash 1270a32a). The 3 minors are edge-cases in the GATED DSO_RESTAGE_EXECUTE=1 path (not production-wired) — fold into the executor-hardening follow-up BEFORE production-wiring: (m1) EXECUTE path is unreferenced + unit-uncovered (by-design advisory-first; needs integration tests); (m2) deterministic fresh-name has no auto-retry escape on a name collision after an interrupted re-stage; (m3) mkdir-lock has no staleness/PID recovery (a killed holder leaves a stale lock → 60s spin + abort). Gate PASSES for manual merge (advisory path is fully tested + default).
